slides.title: Java Tutorial for Beginners 3
slides.subtitle: Variables and Data Types Explained Simply
slides.line3: int, double, char, boolean, long and var

slides.heading: Primitive data types
bullets: long: large whole numbers, ends with L
char: one character in single quotes, for example 'A'

slides.heading: Declaring variables
bullets: Write the type, then the name, then an optional value

slides.heading: The var keyword
bullets: From Java 10, let Java infer the type
The type is still fixed at compile time

slides.heading: Common mistakes
bullets: 1. Using int for money with decimals
2. Forgetting the L on long values
3. Using a variable before giving it a value

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: int, long, double, float, char and boolean are the main types
Use var when the type is obvious
